Taskin to Asalanka, FOUR runs 
finishes it with a four - Sri Lanka cruise to a five-wicket win! Length ball pulled behind 
square and beats the fielder in the deep. Asalanka with the pleasure of the winning runs 
and also remaining not out. 
See all photos 
9.51pm This is the 11th consecutive win for Sri Lanka in ODIs. A convincing win for Sri 
Lanka sets them atop Group B, the group of death, while Bangladesh know that their 
game against Afghanistan on Sunday is now a must-win. A game played in good spirits, 
no dance moves displayed on the field atleast. 
 
The positives for Bangladesh were Shanto's well-built innings and their fielding effort. 
Otherwise, Sri Lanka were too hot on the day, and also showed their bowling bench 
strength is very strong too. Pathirana's four-for led their bowling effort, but Theekshana, 
de Silva and Wellalage were great too. And then, despite an early hiccup, Sri Lanka 
rebuild on the back of a strong partnership from Samarawickrama and Asalanka. Both 
batters finished with half-centuries, a confidence booster ahead of their next game on 
Tuesday against Afghanistan. 
Sadeera Samarawickrama: (Came in at a difficult situation) We were two wickets down 
early so my plan was to bat positive but also continue my batting because we needed 
partnerships. (Conditions) Batting was not easy on this wicket - we saw for both teams. 
Spinning and bit slow to fast bowlers but I just backed myself. That's it. (Driving off the 
front foot and pull shots) I have always backed my strength, that's my strength in 
batting. I work hard for that, so any situation I back these shots." 
Shakib Al Hasan, losing captain: (Not enough runs?) Yes, it was not a 300 wicket, but 
we needed 220-230 runs to make a game. (Responsibility of his batting with no Tamim 
and Litton) Yes more responsibility, I couldn't do it, but as a batting effort we didn't do 
well. We have a big game coming up. (Captaincy in bowling effort) When they are 30 
down for 3, we knew we needed a couple of more wickets, but unfortunately we didn't 
get that. Bowlers and spinners have been doing their bit for a long time now, just not 
enough runs on the board. (Positives for crunch games) There are lot of nerves when 
we started the game but as we kept on batting, in the 20th over, we felt lot more 
comfortable. This is the first time playing Asia Cup and in away conditions." 
10.02pm We'll hear from the winning captain and Player of the Match shortly. 
Dasun Shanaka, the winning captain: "We thought it was a better pitch than the score 
Bangladesh scored. The bowlers stood up. (Wickets) The wickets are being used in the 
LPL so we all know.... (Sadeera and Asalanka) Tricky surface. Sadeera, the way he 
fielded, it was his day. Asalanka is good signs for Sri Lanka cricket." 
Matheesha Pathirana is the POTM: "(Feeling of getting POTM in an ODI) This is my first 
man of the match title for my country, so really happy about it. (T20 skills in ODIs) 
Slower balls are important, that's why I took wickets in the death. Useful skill from T20s 
to fifty overs. My bowling is different so a little unpredictable."

more Asia Cup action!
